_comment: One edit = one config. Swap song/images/sequence for the next video. Times in seconds.
name: take-me-home-4-christmas
vibe: colorful vintage christmas at home: pink + red + pine green, candlelight, paper garlands
_song_comment: The TikTok sound (screen-recorded clip, 24.6 s, ~117.5 BPM). If missing, renders a PREVIEW on a placeholder grid at fallback_bpm.
_song_start_comment: Seconds. Window starts on the downbeat nearest this; null = auto-pick the strongest window.
